name: Holiday Chocolate Fudge, Peppermint Bark & English Toffee (Nut-Free Mod)
whyItWorks: Smooth walnut-free chocolate fudge has zero insoluble fiber, but concentrated sugar, cocoa fat, condensed milk, and peppermint oil (which relaxes the lower esophageal sphincter) make holiday candy plates a high-risk trigger.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If enjoying in remission, choose a single small square of nut-free Vanilla or Chocolate Fudge after a protein-rich meal, and avoid almond/walnut toffee and heavy peppermint bark if prone to reflux.
watchOuts: Often hides chopped walnuts, pecans, or almonds
Peppermint oil can trigger reflux and concentrated sugar can cause osmotic cramping
